_note: Model prices are DATA, not code. Edit this file (or better, your own
override at ~/.config/ai-tools/pricing.json) when prices change or when a
model you use is missing. Nothing here is compiled into the analyzers.
Resolution order, later sources override earlier ones:
1. this file (shipped defaults)
2. ~/.config/ai-tools/pricing.json   (your overrides; survives deploy.sh)
3. $AI_MODEL_PRICING                 (explicit path)
4. --pricing-file FILE               (per-invocation)
Keys are model ids. The most specific match wins (longest literal prefix).
Only 'input' and 'output' are required -- cache rates are derived from the
multipliers in 'defaults' unless the entry states them explicitly.
Two suffix wildcards, and the difference matters:
'X*'  matches X plus VARIANT suffixes only -- X-20260101, X[1m], X@ver.
It deliberately does NOT cross a '.', so 'gpt-5*' never absorbs
gpt-5.6. A new minor version stays unpriced until you price it,
instead of silently inheriting its predecessor's rate.
'X**' matches anything starting with X, '.' included. Use it only when
you genuinely want a whole family pinned to one rate.
A model with no matching entry is reported as unpriced (N/A). That is
deliberate: a wrong number is worse than an honest gap. To price an
internal or private model slug, add it to your override file.
OpenAI rates are standard tier (not batch, flex, or fast) from
https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing. gpt-5-pro offers no
cached-input discount, so its cache_read equals its input rate rather
than being derived from the multiplier.
